text:
- **Go pm replaces Python pm:** The pm repo and the agents repo no longer contain Python pm. Harness tracking now lives in the pm repo, with its full history.
- **Owner requests and pm tools:** Agents now try the work first. They open a tracked need before they ask the owner. A sprint now moves to another project in one command.
- **Site reliability:** The site no longer fails every page while git rewrites the records. Wide diagrams scroll sideways on phones, and images kept beside a record now show.
- **Release notes and CI:** Every pm release note now comes from the changelog, and CI enforces it. The slowest pm check runs much faster than before.
